title: gates: the suite without default features runs the profile gates-no-default-features
goal: Susi's suite without default features reran the repository's own checks (the JetBrains plugin compiled with javac, the VS Code extension's tests in node, the public firewall), about 3.8 s of processor time that the whole suite spends already, on a 4-core VM whose two suites side by side are bound by processor time. A repository that names a nextest profile gates-no-default-features gets it for that suite in gates and speed, as the whole suite gets gates.
